subject: Vendor onboarding checkpoint — invoice exchange SOP & exemplar field mapping
messages:

Cc: vendor-ops@aperture-sys.com
Date: Sat, 4 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding / invoice requirements (Aperture Systems)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for walking through setup this morning. Our vendor-ops team asked me to confirm the invoice exchange options so we can finish our internal onboarding checklist. Quick summary and two asks:

Summary of what we support today:
- Vendor portal (preferred) — CSV or PDF upload, automatic PO matching on PO Number, supports line-level quantities.
- Email ingestion — PDFs emailed to vendor-ops@aperture-sys.com; manual review for unmatched POs.
- SFTP drop (legacy) — nightly batch.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Confirm the exact PO field format Redwood requires for reliable automatic matching (PO prefix, numeric length, any accepted variations).
2) Can you provide an example of a one-page invoice (PDF preferred) with the fields that your AP system requires so our vendor team can align their template? I attached Aperture's current template for reference (Aperture_invoice_template.xlsx).

Also: are there any size limits or preferred filename patterns for emailed invoices? Aperture's accounting system will enforce those on our side if we need to.

Appreciate it — if easier, we can schedule a 20-minute screen share next week.

Best,
Liam Hart
Head of Ops Integration
Aperture Systems

[Attachment: Aperture_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Liam Hart <liam.hart@aperture-sys.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 4 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoice requirements (Aperture Systems)

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear note and the template. Quick answers inline and an attached Redwood exemplar PDF you can share with your vendors.

PO matching
- Required field: PO Number (alphanumeric) — Redwood AP accepts PO numbers with optional prefix (e.g., RDW-12345 or 12345).
- Recommended: include only one PO number per invoice for automatic matching; line-level PO splits are supported when the PO appears on each line.
- Minimum length: 4 numeric characters (we pad internally), max 20 chars.

File/filename limits
- Email ingestion: single PDF up to 12 MB. Multipage PDFs OK. Please avoid password-protected PDFs.
- Portal/Coupa/SFTP: CSV and PDF accepted; CSVs must be UTF-8. Filename convention (recommended): PER-PO_{PO}_{InvoiceNumber}.pdf (helps tracing).

Required invoice fields for automatic ingestion (we'll attach an exemplar):
- Invoice Number
- Invoice Date (YYYY-MM-DD preferred)
- PO Number
- Supplier Legal Name
- Remit To address or remit account id
- Line-level: Description, Qty, Unit Price, Line Total
- Tax Amount (per invoice)
- Currency

Optional but helpful: GL/Cost center code, Ship to location, Project ID.

I've attached a one-page example (Redwood_invoice_exemplar.pdf) that mirrors our ingestion mapping. If your team prefers CSV mapping instead of PDF, we can share a sample CSV row.

Next steps: if Aperture can replicate the attached exemplar, we should be able to onboard you to portal ingestion with automated PO matching. If not, email ingestion is fine temporarily but will require manual validation for unmatched lines.

cc: Mina — can you confirm whether we want to require portal for vendors with > $50k monthly volume? Also pinging Karthik for AP mapping verification.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_invoice_exemplar.pdf (pdf)]

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoice requirements (Aperture Systems)

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note before I reply to Aperture:

Operational stance proposal (for decision)
- Require portal/SFTP onboarding for suppliers with forecasted monthly invoice volume > $50k OR > 50 invoices/month.
- Allow email ingestion for low-volume suppliers during first 60 days of onboarding; convert to portal/SFTP as part of 90-day review.
- Exceptions: strategic partners where a legal team prohibits portal access — engineering to create a whitelist and manual ingestion path.

Field-level mapping (AP system mapping to our ingestion schema) — suggested canonical mapping (send to Aperture):
- invoice_id -> Invoice Number
- invoice_date -> Invoice Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number -> PO Number
- supplier_name -> Supplier Legal Name
- remit_account -> Remit To / Remit Account ID
- line.description -> Line Description
- line.quantity -> Qty
- line.unit_price -> Unit Price
- line.total -> Line Total
- tax_total -> Tax Amount
- currency -> Currency

Operational notes
- If PO number is missing, invoice will route to manual exceptions. We should remind vendors to include PO on the first page header.
- For multi-PO invoices we require a CSV breakout or one invoice per PO for guaranteed automated matching.

I'll send Aperture a short 'acceptance checklist' and the CSV sample row. If you both approve the stance, I'll reply to Liam today and attach the checklist + mapping.

— Mina
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
